svg.title: Microsoft Graph end to end: register the app in Microsoft Entra ID, get a token from the Microsoft identity platform, call graph.microsoft.com, which checks the token, permissions and throttling before routing to Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint and OneDrive, Teams, Intune, Security, Planner and To Do or Purview; changes flow back through webhooks, Event Hubs or Event Grid, delta query and Data Connect
svg.text: 5 CHANGES AND BULK DATA FLOW BACK OUT
validate in 10 s · ack in 3 s
Pull only what changed since last time. Notifications say when, delta says what.
Data Connect is for whole datasets on a schedule; the API is for real-time, per-user or per-tenant calls.
